author: /root
scope: Four previously missing approach labels × zh-CN/zh-TW = eight new static UI values; JA0.

review.method: Compared all four Korean labels and eight accepted targets with MainGame's Starting Conditions and ending details, LocaleManager lookup, and existing %s wrappers.
review.findings: Investment, people, principles and steady life stay compact descriptions of the chosen approach, not performance or rules. Existing wrappers each format one value; both consumers suppress the default free-choice label. Japanese and runtime are unchanged.

preservation.proof: Two canonical receipts and actual UI strings match final responses. Pure append inversion restores all prior dictionary and ledger bytes and order; no existing accepted value changed. JA/KO/EN, runtime and demo were not edited.

validation: Pure check_batch, exact append validation, final check/import VALID with empty stderr, and exact candidate UI_APPEND_HISTORY_OK marker. Initial lane CLI rejection retained; named-lane is selection only. No engine or rendered view.

identity.encoding: Raw canonical JSON basename-sorted [basename,bytes,sha256]; rows [locale,id,source-hash,previous-target-hash,target-hash] in export order.
